name: Employee Average Table Time
query:
SELECT
    pi.waiter AS "Waiter:Data:200",


    ROUND(
        AVG(
            TIME_TO_SEC(
                ADDTIME('00:00:00', pi.total_spend_time)
            )
        ) / 60,
        2
    ) AS "Average Table Time (Minutes):Float:220"

FROM
    `tabPOS Invoice` pi

LEFT JOIN
    `tabURY Report Settings` rs
    ON rs.branch = %(branch)s

WHERE
    pi.docstatus = 1
    AND IFNULL(pi.waiter, '') != ''
    AND pi.branch = %(branch)s

    AND
    (
        (
            (rs.hours IS NULL OR rs.hours = 0)

            AND pi.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
        )

        OR

        (
            rs.hours > 0

            AND TIMESTAMP(
                pi.posting_date,
                pi.posting_time
            )

            >= TIMESTAMP(
                %(from_date)s,
                CONCAT(LPAD(rs.hours, 2, '0'), ':00:00')
            )

            AND TIMESTAMP(
                pi.posting_date,
                pi.posting_time
            )

            <= TIMESTAMP(
                DATE_ADD(%(to_date)s, INTERVAL 1 DAY),
                CONCAT(LPAD(rs.hours, 2, '0'), ':00:00')
            )
        )

        OR

        (
            rs.branch IS NULL

            AND pi.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
        )
    )

GROUP BY
    pi.waiter

ORDER BY
    ROUND(
        AVG(
            TIME_TO_SEC(
                ADDTIME('00:00:00', pi.total_spend_time)
            )
        ) / 60,
        2
    ) DESC
